purpose: Prevent readable static recovery output from being promoted to verified runtime or replay truth without supporting evidence.

states.label: Static inferred
states.promotion_rule: Default state for static deobfuscation, AST cleanup, bundle splitting, and semantic renaming.

states.label: Runtime correlated
required_inputs: matched request field, function output, or callframe fact
states.promotion_rule: Allowed only when browser evidence ties the static output to an observed runtime fact.

states.label: Replay verified
required_inputs: accepted replay record or server acceptance evidence
field-level parity or accepted response status
states.promotion_rule: Allowed only when replay or server acceptance supports the recovered behavior.

states.label: Runtime divergent
required_inputs: runtime evidence with mismatch or non-equivalence status
states.promotion_rule: Blocks delivery when readable recovered code is contradicted by observed runtime behavior.

risk_signals.risk: Readable branches may be intentionally unused or misleading.
Static output may depend on browser state that local recovery did not reproduce.
Renamed symbols are analyst convenience, not new evidence.
Readable recovered code may be intentionally non-equivalent to the runtime path.

default_gate.rule: Readable static output lowers reading cost. It does not prove runtime behavior, server acceptance, or replay parity.
